description: The Goshawk was born during troubled times. With the initial order for a batch of new transports being made just at the cusp of the Inter-Corporate War, the constantly changing scope of the conflict led to numerous revisions. From a fleet combatant, to a stealth carrier, to a counter-insurgency craft. The first Goshawks (which were an extensive compromise between the many priorities) rolled out of the Shipyards mere days before the conclusion of the war - now, they serve Vigilitas Interstellar as one of their largest independently-operating security vessels in the Frontier. The Goshawk has earned a reputation for crew comfort, including many amenities that are rare or nonexistent on other vessels in its weight class.
